selected_evidence.requirement: usb-storage blocked from loading (module blacklisted) before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed module not loaded; blacklist config was written; modprobe attempt then failed with retcode 1 / Invalid argument, proving the block is active

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistence across reboot ensured via initramfs regeneration
selected_evidence.summary: Identified running kernel/initramfs, rebuilt initramfs with dracut omitting usb-storage, and confirmed via lsinitrd that usb_storage is absent from the rebuilt image
Captured pre-restart boot_id and confirmed system running / sshd active

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command issued (stream closed as node went down), polled through downtime, then exec succeeded again with a new boot_id (22a96ec2...) differing from baseline (96974ac3...), proving an actual restart
After reboot: system running, sshd active, blacklist config file still present, usb_storage not loaded, and modprobe usb-storage still fails, proving the block persists across reboot

printf 'install usb-storage /bin/false\nblacklist usb-storage\n' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf; echo "---"; cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

commands.command: sudo dracut -f --omit-drivers usb-storage /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img $(uname -r) 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "dracut exit: $?"
lsinitrd /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img 2>/dev/null | grep -i usb_storage; echo "grep exit: $? (1 expected = not found)"

sudo systemctl reboot & disown; sleep 1; echo "reboot issued"
